title: Component
description: The declarative schema of a single OpenReasoningComponents (ORC) component: a self-contained unit of knowledge grounded in a dataset and designed to be embedded in LLM reasoning. This is the open standard; implementations load this schema as data and validate against it rather than mirroring it in code. Where this schema and spec/component.md disagree, this schema is authoritative.

id.description: Namespaced identifier, '<namespace>/<name>'. The namespace identifies the producing system or organization; the name identifies the component within that namespace. Case-sensitive; the '/' separator appears exactly once.

type.description: The component type. v0 defines: column, metric, slice, distribution, statistical_association, threshold_rule, model_component, domain_knowledge, segment. Systems may define additional, namespaced custom types (e.g. 'x_interaction_effect'); this field is an open string, not a closed enum, so a custom type is not itself a validation failure.

scope.description: The dataset this component is grounded in. Resolution of the dataset identifier to a catalog entry, file path, or schema is the responsibility of the system using the component.

statement.description: The canonical representation: a natural language description of what the component captures, meant to be woven into a chain of thought. All other fields are auxiliary to this one.

relations.description: Directed edges to other components. Every edge points from this component to a target component.

structure.description: Auxiliary structured metadata supporting retrieval, filtering, validation and other programmatic operations. Has no required fields and no prescribed schema; its contents are determined by the component's type. Not canonical -- the statement is.

evidence.description: Statistical or empirical support for the component. Free-form: the spec does not prescribe a statistical framework. A component with no evidence is treated as an unsupported assertion.

source.description: Origin category: 'derived', 'human', or a custom value.

model.description: Identifier of the model used, if applicable.

derivation.description: Identifier of the external, versioned computation that produced this component (e.g. an Open Derivation Spec derivation name), if any. Generic: any system may populate this with whatever it calls its own versioned computation. Absent for a hand-authored component with no backing computation.

derivation_version.description: The content-hash (or equivalent) version of the derivation named in 'derivation' at the time this component was generated. Lets a consumer decide whether the component is still current by comparing this value against the derivation's current version, without this spec needing any refresh machinery of its own.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for system- or application-specific use.

type.description: Relationship type. v0 defines: depends_on (refresh dependency), derived_from (generative dependency, implies depends_on), supports (evidence for the target, no refresh dependency). Systems may define additional relation types as needed; this field is an open string, not a closed enum.
